verdict.rationale: Motion ships several built-in AI capabilities that take work off the user's hands. The AI Meeting Notetaker 'takes perfect notes and follows-up with action items for you', the AI Search Assistant finds docs and tasks, and the AI Workflow Builder builds workflows from SOPs. Its scheduler also auto-places and reshuffles tasks, including ones created by voice or forwarded email. However, these are narrow, feature-specific automations rather than a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to, and all evidence is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: a general-purpose conversational assistant or agent that accepts and executes delegated tasks end to end, documentation of how delegation works and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
